publish-a11y-disclosure.title: 无障碍 Play 审核 disclosure 强化（onboarding copy + strings.xml）
publish-a11y-disclosure.description:
现状：onboarding 已有 WizardStep.Accessibility 这一步（OnboardingSteps.kt 中 permissionStepCopy），用户主动点 "Open Accessibility Settings" 跳转系统设置启用——这就是 affirmative consent 流程。但当前 copy 对 Play 审核而言不够，缺三件 Play 政策必查的内容：(a) 屏幕内容会发给 LLM 提供商；(b) 隐私政策链接；(c) 不在后台运行的明确说明。strings.xml 里 accessibility_service_description 也太简单（这是 Android 系统 Settings 里看服务时展开的描述，Play 审核也看）。

要做的事（窄）：
1. 重写 OnboardingSteps.kt 中 WizardStep.Accessibility 的 description（保留同样视觉布局，只扩 copy），加入 LLM 数据流向 / 隐私政策链接 / not-in-background 保证。
2. 重写 strings.xml 中 accessibility_service_description 为 200+ 字符详细版（覆盖：服务做什么 / 何时激活 / 何时不激活 / 用户控制权）。

不做：不新增独立 consent dialog，不动 onboarding 结构。Affirmative consent 由用户主动点 Open Accessibility Settings 提供，符合 Play 政策（Voice Access 同模式）。

详见 projects/active/1_publish/3_privacy_claude.md, projects/active/1_publish/5_play_store_claude.md。
acceptCriteria: accessibility_service_description 字符串 > 200 字符且覆盖：服务做什么 / 何时激活 / 用户控制权

publish-storage-permissions-cleanup.description: AndroidManifest.xml 中声明的 READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE / WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE 在 targetSdk=36 下系统已完全忽略（Scoped Storage 自 API 30 起 / READ_MEDIA_* 自 API 33 起），属于 historical residue。代码实际使用：(1) BrowserScriptJsInterface 截图写到 /sdcard/Android/data/<package>/ — 这是 app-private external dir，API 19+ 无需任何权限；(2) WorkspaceShellPromptSection 提示 agent 用 Termux shell cp 文件，那是 Termux 的权限不是本 app 的。删掉这两行 manifest，无功能变化。修复 ScopedStorage lint warning，减少 Play 审核 friction，简化 Data Safety 表。详见 projects/active/1_publish/3_privacy_claude.md。⚠️ 与 publish-encrypted-prefs 的依赖只是文档分组习惯，技术上无强依赖；可独立完成。

voice-recognizer-adapter.title: Recognizer interface + AndroidRecognizer impl
voice-recognizer-adapter.description: Define a JVM-clean Recognizer interface and the only file in the project that imports android.speech.*. Surface: interface Recognizer { start(languageTag, callbacks); stop(); cancel(); destroy() }, interface RecognizerCallbacks { onPartial(String); onFinal(String); onError(VoiceError) }, enum VoiceError { NoMatch, SpeechTimeout, Network, NetworkTimeout, LanguageUnavailable, InsufficientPermissions, Busy, ServiceDied, Unknown }, interface RecognizerFactory { isAvailable(): Boolean; create(): Recognizer? }. voice-controller.title: VoiceInputController + state machine + JVM tests
voice-controller.description: Compose-scoped controller wrapping Recognizer. State machine: Idle / Listening / Stopping / Unavailable. Generation rule (Codex round 3): increment on cancel(), destroy(), AND after processing ANY terminal callback (natural Listening->Idle on onResults, Stopping->Idle, error->Idle). Do NOT increment on Listening->Stopping (the terminal callback we are waiting for must match the current generation). partialAtStop snapshot frozen on user-tap-stop; partials arriving during Stopping do not overwrite it. Error matrix per design (NO_MATCH/TIMEOUT user-stop commits partialAtStop; NETWORK/LANG/CLIENT toast+restore; INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS re-runs the gate; LANGUAGE_NOT_SUPPORTED disables mic for the session). Availability re-checked on start() via factory.isAvailable(); transitions to Unavailable on hard service errors. DisposableEffect calls destroy() + bumps generation + sets disposed flag.
acceptCriteria: VoiceInputController.kt exists and does NOT import android.speech.*
Public surface: state, lastPartial, partialAtStop, start(baseText), stop(), cancel()

JVM test stop-then-final: final wins over partialAtStop
JVM test destroy-mid-listen: all subsequent callbacks dropped
JVM test double-start-while-stopping: second start is a no-op

voice-permission-gate.title: VoicePermissionGate + MainActivity cold-start route
voice-permission-gate.description: Permission gate mirrors RunCommandPermissionGate (Granted/Request/OpenAppSettings classifier + pending flag preventing rapid-tap stacking). MAIN_APP path uses rememberLauncherForActivityResult(RequestPermission()). Overlay path calls new AgentService.requestVoicePermissionViaMainActivity() helper that fires the existing bringMainAppToFront pattern with an INTERNAL extra EXTRA_REQUEST_VOICE_PERMISSION — no exported intent action. MainActivity adds consumeVoicePermissionRequestIfPresent(intent) called from BOTH onCreate AND onNewIntent (Codex round 2: cold-start does not hit onNewIntent). The helper sets pendingVoicePermissionRequest flag; a LaunchedEffect(launcherReady, pendingVoicePermissionRequest) in the Compose tree fires the launcher once both are true, bridging the cold-start launcher-not-yet-registered race. Voice extra does NOT flow through handleIntent / MainActivityIntentPayloadApplier.
